messages:
sarah-sales: MerchantGate (enterprise fintech) is leaning toward a swap from RivalAPI. They want a short POC for a compat-layer + security Q answers. Can we scope? Need pricing delta, sample prompt parity tests, and known response deltas. @mike-ps @linus-eng @anita-sec pls.

mike-ps: On it. Timeline? They want a demo next Wed. I'll own POC coordination. Need sample prompts & expected outputs.

linus-eng: Quick note: RivalAPI does newline-normalization + different tokenization for emojis. Also streaming chunk sizes differ -> affects latency on streaming UI. We should do side-by-side diff with our model and Rival's. I can build a drop-in shim that rewrites Rival v1 -> Redwood API mapping.

sarah-sales: Great. For prompts: marketing copy, transaction parsing, dispute classification. I'll drop sample prompts in the thread.

jordan-cs: Pricing ask: merchant expects per-call parity. Two options to propose: 1) Usage-based (per token/embedding) + small adapter surcharge; 2) Reserved capacity for predictable throughput -> lower unit cost. For POC we can offer usage credits.

anita-sec: Security questionnaire: they'll send a vendor SOC2+kms checklist. Immediate asks I need answers for: KMS/HSM support, VPC/private deployment, audit log retention, data residency options, customer-managed keys. Also need SCIF for legal review. If they need on-prem, that'll shift timeline.

linus-eng: Shim prototype (pseudo):
```
# pseudo
POST /v1/requests -> map to /v2/generate
headers['X-Client'] = 'merchantgate'
map param 'prompt' -> 'messages[0].content'
handle streaming: buffer chunks and emit same chunk sizes
```
I'll push a branch by EOD.

sarah-sales: :thumbsup: @linus-eng please add test harness with RivalAPI sample responses so we can flag parity diffs automatically.

mike-ps: I'll run through security Q and gather their baseline. Also, need to confirm rate limits they currently have with Rival.

anita-sec: One blocker: MerchantGate requires customer-managed keys (bring-your-own-kms). We support CMK for Private but not hosted by default. Need product decision or an enterprise contract clause.

jordan-cs: If CMK isn't available for hosted, propose hybrid: Dedicated with customer keys + SLA. That's usually acceptable. Pricing bump ~15-25%.

sarah-sales: Action items:
- linus-eng: prototype shim + test harness (due in 2 business days)
- mike-ps: collect Rival rate limits & sample responses (due tomorrow)
- anita-sec: draft security answer doc and list of gaps (due 48h)
- jordan-cs: pricing scenarios + delta for CMK/dedicated (due EOD Fri)
I'll sync with their procurement after we have docs.

deploy-bot: staging branch redwood/compat/merchantgate-shim created by linus-eng.

linus-eng: Created branch and pushed initial mapping + unit tests. Link: https://git.internal/rw/compat/merchantgate-shim (they may not have access).

sarah-sales: Thanks — I'll share prototype link privately with their tech lead and schedule demo. Any blockers call out here.

anita-sec: Legal wants to see a draft MSA addendum for CMK. I'll start one and loop in legal.
